title: THE FREE-DUST ABUNDANCE FROM THE CLUSTER SIDE -- the state of the one open parameter

definitions.floor_A: rho_ph(r) = sqrt(G M_b(<r) a0)/(4 pi G r^2), M_b per bin, no cap, no fit (G057 col a; the G03G/G075 floor in density form)
definitions.floor_B: share_k(r) = (1 + g_tot(r)/(4 a0))^-2 of the residual (G059's certified-kernel partition, sub-a0 oriented)
definitions.f_dust: rho_dust,req/rho_res = 1 - rho_ph,laws/rho_res, fraction of the missing mass; negative = the floor overshoots the residual
definitions.alpha_relation: T_pred/T_obs = (R500/2) sqrt(a0/(G M_dyn)) (M_b/M_dyn)^(1/2) from G075's identity; fitted power alpha on the 12 clusters

V2.statement: PROFILE: the required f_dust varies far beyond 20% across 0.2-1 R500 on both zero-parameter floors

V4.statement: THE OPEN PARAMETER IS NOT ONE NUMBER PER CLUSTER.  With the law's phantom floor fixed (zero free parameters: the certified-EOS density sqrt(G M_b a0)/(4 pi G r^2), floor A, and the mu2-kernel share, floor B), the REQUIRED free-dust fraction of the missing mass varies radially inside 0.2-1 R500 by a median (max-min)/median = 0.91 (floor A, resolved window) / 0.72 (floor B, full window) -- a median 5.1x inner-to-outer swing on the primary floor, far beyond any 20% flatness bar.  The inner region (0.2-0.5 R500) requires f_dust ~ 0.78-0.63 median (the missing mass is mostly free dust there), falling to ~0.2-0.5 toward R500.  On floor A the requirement crosses zero at a median 897 kpc (in-window on 4/12 clusters): beyond it the uncapped law alone overshoots the LOCAL residual -- G012's registered uncapped overshoot (1.86-2.21x at 420 kpc) restated per radius; the outer window is additionally UNRESOLVED in the local-density reading where M_FORW's slope saturates (median censored fraction 0% of the window points; the enclosed-mass reading, immune to this, shows the cumulative dust fraction still falling from ~0.8 at 0.2 R500 to ~0.5 at R500).  The EFE-capped reading (G050/G057's operative cH0 cap: phantom support zero across the window, G057 V2) is the ONLY committed reading in which the dust is trivially one number (100% of the deficit, flat by construction, zero information).  The temperature ratio agrees with the mass inversion within the kTvir errors (G095's closed form T_obs/T_floor = 2 f r_M/R500, power alpha ~ 0.75, structural 2/3; fitted slope 0.2104733 reproduced from G104 digit-for-digit; median |dlog(q_T/q_M)| = 0.032 vs median error 0.057), so the deficit itself is one number per cluster (median f_dark = 4.7 at R500 -- G095's f = 5.66 = the same number in total-to-baryon units), but its PHANTOM/DUST SPLIT is a radial function fixed by the law's own zero-parameter floor.
